requirements.requirement: Sales reps must be able to track leads from initial contact through qualification, with automatic lead scoring based on demographic and behavioral data.
The system must send automated email notifications to customers when their support case status changes (e.g., from Open to In Progress, or Resolved).
Field technicians need a mobile app to view their daily work orders, capture before/after photos, record parts used, and collect digital signatures from customers.
The system must integrate in real-time with our legacy SAP ERP to synchronize purchase orders, goods receipts, and vendor invoices bidirectionally with conflict resolution.
Finance team needs to define multi-level budget controls with approval workflows. Purchases exceeding budget thresholds should be blocked until a manager approves an override.
Warehouse managers need AI-driven demand forecasting that accounts for seasonality, promotions, and external market signals to auto-generate replenishment orders.
The system must provide a 360-degree customer view showing all interactions (emails, calls, meetings, cases, orders, invoices) in a single timeline regardless of which department handled them.
HR managers need to configure custom performance review cycles with multi-rater (360°) feedback, competency-based ratings, and automatic calibration workflows.

The application must support a custom approval matrix where purchase order approvals are routed based on amount thresholds, cost center, and requester seniority level, with delegation and escalation rules.

Marketing team needs to run multi-channel marketing campaigns (email, SMS, social media) with A/B testing, real-time engagement tracking, and automatic lead handoff to Sales when a lead score threshold is reached.
